summary: Controller installs collections from collections/requirements.yml in the project during the implicit sync before a job; Enable Collection(s) Download under Settings > Automation Execution > Job turns it off, and project-requirement collections take precedence over those in the execution environment regardless of version.
questions: How do I install collections for a project in automation controller?
Which wins, a collection in requirements.yml or in the execution environment?
How do I disable automatic collection download?

answer_card.title: Project collections vs execution environment
answer_card.answer_md: If the project has `collections/requirements.yml`, controller installs those collections before the job runs. They **take precedence** over collections built into the execution environment, even if the requirements version is older. Disable with **Settings > Automation Execution > Job > Enable Collection(s) Download**.
